title: 第3章 千宝楼与曲师叔第4章 无瑕丹药
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
……
半个时辰后。
……
只听“咔”的一声。
房门被从里面打开了。
陈岚那曼妙身影走了出来，
“师兄，那我回去了！”
陈岚转身关上了房门。
朝着屋内说了一声。
“嗯，师妹，路上小心！”
听着屋内李师兄那略显疲惫的声音
门外的陈岚抿嘴一笑。
转身扭动着曼妙腰身进入了院子。
曼妙娇躯紧跟着飞身而起，御剑远去了。
【+5好感】
【+25副职经验】
系统的提示让李蒙嘴角露出了一丝微笑。
他就说了一句关心的话而已。
没想到就加了5点好感度。
女人还真是感性的生物啊。

李蒙坐了起来，盘腿而坐。
仔细的研究起了自己的“金手指”。
“金手指”就一个页面。
页面上显示的是自己的角色信息。
给人一种玩游戏的感觉。
“藏宝阁？”
李蒙突然发现页面中还有一个子页面。
李蒙伸手在虚空中一点。
藏宝阁页面突然跳了出来。
“什么藏宝阁，不就是丹方，符箓，阵盘，炼器的制作方法嘛？”
李蒙还以为能够从藏宝阁得到什么好东西呢。
算了，有总比没有好。
不劳而获也没有什么意思。
李蒙倒在了床上，看起了藏宝阁。
“一品丹方可真够多的！”
一眼望去足有二十多个。
甚至有养魂类的丹方。
要知道养魂类的丹药一般都是三品丹药。
只有一些上古丹方才能炼制出一品养魂类丹药。
符箓也不少，有十几个。

炼器也不少，有二十多个法器炼制方法。
content_en:
…
Half an hour later.
…
Just listen to a "click" sound.
The door was opened from the inside.
Chen Lan’s graceful figure walked out,
"Brother, I'm going back then!"
Chen Lan turned around and closed the door.
He said towards the house.
"Well, junior sister, be careful on the road!"
Listening to the slightly tired voice of Senior Brother Li in the room
Chen Lan outside the door pursed her lips and smiled.
Turning around and twisting her graceful waist, she entered the yard.
The graceful and delicate body flew up immediately, and the sword flew away.
[+5 favorability]
[+25 deputy job experience]
The system prompts a smile on Li Meng's lips.
He just said a word of concern.
Unexpectedly, 5 points of favorability were added.
Women are really emotional creatures.
Li Meng sat up and crossed his legs.
I carefully studied my "golden finger".
"Goldfinger" is just one page.
What is displayed on the page is your own role information.
It gives people the feeling of playing a game.
"Treasure Pavilion?"
Li Meng suddenly discovered that there was a sub-page in the page.
Li Meng stretched out his hand a little in the void.
The Treasure Pavilion page suddenly popped up.
"What is the Treasure Pavilion? Isn't it just the method of making elixirs, talismans, formation plates, and refining weapons?"
Li Meng thought he could get something good from the Treasure Pavilion.
Forget it, it's better than nothing.
There is no point in getting something for nothing.
Li Meng fell on the bed and looked at the Treasure Pavilion.
"There are so many pills at the first level!"
At a glance, there were more than twenty.
There are even soul-nourishing elixirs.
You must know that soul-nourishing elixirs are generally third-grade elixirs.
Only some ancient elixir recipes can refine first-grade soul-nourishing elixirs.
There are also many talismans, more than a dozen.
There are also many weapons refining, and there are more than twenty methods for refining magical weapons.
